title: Acquire and integrate another business
summary: When the company evaluates purchasing another company, product line or business assets. An authorized acquisition decision and controlled integration with reconciled assets, people and obligations.
outcomes: An authorized acquisition decision and controlled integration with reconciled assets, people and obligations.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When the company evaluates purchasing another company, product line or business assets.

parts.title: Define the acquisition thesis and capacity
parts.guidance: State the customer, product or capability sought, available funding and acceptable operating risk. Model the standalone and integrated cases and identify what must be true for the purchase to create value.

references.title: SBA close or sell your business

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve diligence scope and transaction authority
parts.guidance: Leadership and advisers verify the counterparty, confidentiality, structure and conflicts. Approve a bounded diligence budget and access plan without committing to buy before the required evidence is available.

references.title: SBA close or sell your business

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Approve diligence scope and transaction authority

parts.title: Conduct a controlled diligence and integration assessment
parts.guidance: Reconcile financial, customer, employee, IP, security, product and contract evidence. Record unsupported claims, liabilities and integration dependencies with owners and decision impact.

references.title: SBA close or sell your business

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve terms, conditions and integration governance
parts.guidance: The authorized decision makers review price, financing, conditions, warranties and transition obligations with counsel. Assign a responsible integration lead and protect critical customer and workforce continuity.

references.title: SBA close or sell your business

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Approve terms, conditions and integration governance

parts.title: Complete closing through the reviewed process
parts.guidance: Authorized advisers and operators verify approvals, settlement instructions and closing conditions. Retain transaction evidence before changing ownership records or taking control of acquired systems.

references.title: SBA close or sell your business

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Complete closing through the reviewed process

parts.title: Execute and measure the approved integration plan
parts.guidance: Reconcile acquired assets and obligations, phase access and data migrations safely and track customer and employee commitments. Review actual outcomes against the thesis and maintain owners for unresolved liabilities.

references.title: SBA close or sell your business

execution.rationale: Authorized integration owners execute the approved migration and access plan, reconcile acquired assets and obligations, and review unresolved liabilities. Preparation alone does not authorize production access or data changes.

verify.how: An authorized acquisition decision and controlled integration with reconciled assets, people and obligations.

approval.scope: Execute and measure the approved integration plan

references.title: SBA close or sell your business

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
